quran_text_all_rows.arabic_uthmani: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
إِنَّا فَتَحْنَا لَكَ فَتْحًۭا مُّبِينًۭا
لِّيَغْفِرَ لَكَ ٱللَّهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِن ذَنۢبِكَ وَمَا تَأَخَّرَ وَيُتِمَّ نِعْمَتَهُۥ عَلَيْكَ وَيَهْدِيَكَ صِرَٰطًۭا مُّسْتَقِيمًۭا
وَيَنصُرَكَ ٱللَّهُ نَصْرًا عَزِيزًا
هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنزَلَ ٱلسَّكِينَةَ فِى قُلُوبِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ لِيَزْدَادُوٓا۟ إِيمَٰنًۭا مَّعَ إِيمَٰنِهِمْ ۗ وَلِلَّهِ جُنُودُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًۭا
لِّيُدْخِلَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَٰتِ جَنَّٰتٍۢ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا وَيُكَفِّرَ عَنْهُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِمْ ۚ وَكَانَ ذَٰلِكَ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ فَوْزًا عَظِيمًۭا

وَيُعَذِّبَ ٱلْمُنَٰفِقِينَ وَٱلْمُنَٰفِقَٰتِ وَٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ وَٱلْمُشْرِكَٰتِ ٱلظَّآنِّينَ بِٱللَّهِ ظَنَّ ٱلسَّوْءِ ۚ عَلَيْهِمْ دَآئِرَةُ ٱلسَّوْءِ ۖ وَغَضِبَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَعَنَهُمْ وَأَعَدَّ لَهُمْ جَهَنَّمَ ۖ وَسَآءَتْ مَصِيرًۭا
وَلِلَّهِ جُنُودُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَزِيزًا حَكِيمًا
إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَٰكَ شَٰهِدًۭا وَمُبَشِّرًۭا وَنَذِيرًۭا
لِّتُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ وَتُعَزِّرُوهُ وَتُوَقِّرُوهُ وَتُسَبِّحُوهُ بُكْرَةًۭ وَأَصِيلًا

إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُبَايِعُونَكَ إِنَّمَا يُبَايِعُونَ ٱللَّهَ يَدُ ٱللَّهِ فَوْقَ أَيْدِيهِمْ ۚ فَمَن نَّكَثَ فَإِنَّمَا يَنكُثُ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَنْ أَوْفَىٰ بِمَا عَٰهَدَ عَلَيْهُ ٱللَّهَ فَسَيُؤْتِيهِ أَجْرًا عَظِيمًۭا

سَيَقُولُ لَكَ ٱلْمُخَلَّفُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَعْرَابِ شَغَلَتْنَآ أَمْوَٰلُنَا وَأَهْلُونَا فَٱسْتَغْفِرْ لَنَا ۚ يَقُولُونَ بِأَلْسِنَتِهِم مَّا لَيْسَ فِى قُلُوبِهِمْ ۚ قُلْ فَمَن يَمْلِكُ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًٔا إِنْ أَرَادَ بِكُمْ ضَرًّا أَوْ أَرَادَ بِكُمْ نَفْعًۢا ۚ بَلْ كَانَ ٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرًۢا
بَلْ ظَنَنتُمْ أَن لَّن يَنقَلِبَ ٱلرَّسُولُ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِيهِمْ أَبَدًۭا وَزُيِّنَ ذَٰلِكَ فِى قُلُوبِكُمْ وَظَنَنتُمْ ظَنَّ ٱلسَّوْءِ وَكُنتُمْ قَوْمًۢا بُورًۭا
وَمَن لَّمْ يُؤْمِنۢ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ فَإِنَّآ أَعْتَدْنَا لِلْكَٰفِرِينَ سَعِيرًۭا
وَلِلَّهِ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ يَغْفِرُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيُعَذِّبُ مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ غَفُورًۭا رَّحِيمًۭا

سَيَقُولُ ٱلْمُخَلَّفُونَ إِذَا ٱنطَلَقْتُمْ إِلَىٰ مَغَانِمَ لِتَأْخُذُوهَا ذَرُونَا نَتَّبِعْكُمْ ۖ يُرِيدُونَ أَن يُبَدِّلُوا۟ كَلَٰمَ ٱللَّهِ ۚ قُل لَّن تَتَّبِعُونَا كَذَٰلِكُمْ قَالَ ٱللَّهُ مِن قَبْلُ ۖ فَسَيَقُولُونَ بَلْ تَحْسُدُونَنَا ۚ بَلْ كَانُوا۟ لَا يَفْقَهُونَ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا

قُل لِّلْمُخَلَّفِينَ مِنَ ٱلْأَعْرَابِ سَتُدْعَوْنَ إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍ أُو۟لِى بَأْسٍۢ شَدِيدٍۢ تُقَٰتِلُونَهُمْ أَوْ يُسْلِمُونَ ۖ فَإِن تُطِيعُوا۟ يُؤْتِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ أَجْرًا حَسَنًۭا ۖ وَإِن تَتَوَلَّوْا۟ كَمَا تَوَلَّيْتُم مِّن قَبْلُ يُعَذِّبْكُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًۭا

لَّيْسَ عَلَى ٱلْأَعْمَىٰ حَرَجٌۭ وَلَا عَلَى ٱلْأَعْرَجِ حَرَجٌۭ وَلَا عَلَى ٱلْمَرِيضِ حَرَجٌۭ ۗ وَمَن يُطِعِ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ يُدْخِلْهُ جَنَّٰتٍۢ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ ۖ وَمَن يَتَوَلَّ يُعَذِّبْهُ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًۭا
۞ لَّقَدْ رَضِىَ ٱللَّهُ عَنِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ إِذْ يُبَايِعُونَكَ تَحْتَ ٱلشَّجَرَةِ فَعَلِمَ مَا فِى قُلُوبِهِمْ فَأَنزَلَ ٱلسَّكِينَةَ عَلَيْهِمْ وَأَثَٰبَهُمْ فَتْحًۭا قَرِيبًۭا
وَمَغَانِمَ كَثِيرَةًۭ يَأْخُذُونَهَا ۗ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَزِيزًا حَكِيمًۭا
وَعَدَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ مَغَانِمَ كَثِيرَةًۭ تَأْخُذُونَهَا فَعَجَّلَ لَكُمْ هَٰذِهِۦ وَكَفَّ أَيْدِىَ ٱلنَّاسِ عَنكُمْ وَلِتَكُونَ ءَايَةًۭ لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَيَهْدِيَكُمْ صِرَٰطًۭا مُّسْتَقِيمًۭا
وَأُخْرَىٰ لَمْ تَقْدِرُوا۟ عَلَيْهَا قَدْ أَحَاطَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَا ۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرًۭا
وَلَوْ قَٰتَلَكُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَوَلَّوُا۟ ٱلْأَدْبَٰرَ ثُمَّ لَا يَجِدُونَ وَلِيًّۭا وَلَا نَصِيرًۭا
سُنَّةَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّتِى قَدْ خَلَتْ مِن قَبْلُ ۖ وَلَن تَجِدَ لِسُنَّةِ ٱللَّهِ تَبْدِيلًۭا
وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى كَفَّ أَيْدِيَهُمْ عَنكُمْ وَأَيْدِيَكُمْ عَنْهُم بِبَطْنِ مَكَّةَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ أَنْ أَظْفَرَكُمْ عَلَيْهِمْ ۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرًا

هُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَصَدُّوكُمْ عَنِ ٱلْمَسْجِدِ ٱلْحَرَامِ وَٱلْهَدْىَ مَعْكُوفًا أَن يَبْلُغَ مَحِلَّهُۥ ۚ وَلَوْلَا رِجَالٌۭ مُّؤْمِنُونَ وَنِسَآءٌۭ مُّؤْمِنَٰتٌۭ لَّمْ تَعْلَمُوهُمْ أَن تَطَـُٔوهُمْ فَتُصِيبَكُم مِّنْهُم مَّعَرَّةٌۢ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍۢ ۖ لِّيُدْخِلَ ٱللَّهُ فِى رَحْمَتِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ لَوْ تَزَيَّلُوا۟ لَعَذَّبْنَا ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا

إِذْ جَعَلَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فِى قُلُوبِهِمُ ٱلْحَمِيَّةَ حَمِيَّةَ ٱلْجَٰهِلِيَّةِ فَأَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ سَكِينَتَهُۥ عَلَىٰ رَسُولِهِۦ وَعَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَأَلْزَمَهُمْ كَلِمَةَ ٱلتَّقْوَىٰ وَكَانُوٓا۟ أَحَقَّ بِهَا وَأَهْلَهَا ۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمًۭا

لَّقَدْ صَدَقَ ٱللَّهُ رَسُولَهُ ٱلرُّءْيَا بِٱلْحَقِّ ۖ لَتَدْخُلُنَّ ٱلْمَسْجِدَ ٱلْحَرَامَ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ءَامِنِينَ مُحَلِّقِينَ رُءُوسَكُمْ وَمُقَصِّرِينَ لَا تَخَافُونَ ۖ فَعَلِمَ مَا لَمْ تَعْلَمُوا۟ فَجَعَلَ مِن دُونِ ذَٰلِكَ فَتْحًۭا قَرِيبًا
هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَرْسَلَ رَسُولَهُۥ بِٱلْهُدَىٰ وَدِينِ ٱلْحَقِّ لِيُظْهِرَهُۥ عَلَى ٱلدِّينِ كُلِّهِۦ ۚ وَكَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ شَهِيدًۭا

مُّحَمَّدٌۭ رَّسُولُ ٱللَّهِ ۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ مَعَهُۥٓ أَشِدَّآءُ عَلَى ٱلْكُفَّارِ رُحَمَآءُ بَيْنَهُمْ ۖ تَرَىٰهُمْ رُكَّعًۭا سُجَّدًۭا يَبْتَغُونَ فَضْلًۭا مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرِضْوَٰنًۭا ۖ سِيمَاهُمْ فِى وُجُوهِهِم مِّنْ أَثَرِ ٱلسُّجُودِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ مَثَلُهُمْ فِى ٱلتَّوْرَىٰةِ ۚ وَمَثَلُهُمْ فِى ٱلْإِنجِيلِ كَزَرْعٍ أَخْرَجَ شَطْـَٔهُۥ فَـَٔازَرَهُۥ فَٱسْتَغْلَظَ فَٱسْتَوَىٰ عَلَىٰ سُوقِهِۦ يُعْجِبُ ٱلزُّرَّاعَ لِيَغِيظَ بِهِمُ ٱلْكُفَّارَ ۗ وَعَدَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ مِنْهُم مَّغْفِرَةًۭ وَأَجْرًا عَظِيمًۢا

parent_channels.name: P1: Opened Flow and Cultivated Enclosure

subchannels.name: Outlet, Watercourse, and River
subchannels.scene_or_process: A blocked source opens, follows a low channel, and cuts a running course through the ground.
subchannels.active_motifs: water outlet (`quranic:root_001124:B005/m01`); watercourse or valley-tail (`quranic:root_000521:B004/m01`); river cutting the ground (`quranic:root_001559:B001/m01`); widened opening for water to run (`quranic:root_001559:B003/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 48:1 `فتحنا` and `فتحا` (ف ت ح); 48:2 `ذنبك` (ذ ن ب); 48:5 `الأنهار` (ن ه ر).
subchannels.synthesis: The opening functions as a hydraulic outlet rather than a static breach. The same scene gives the trailing watercourse a directional role and lets the river complete the opening by carving and widening a path for sustained movement.

subchannels.name: Irrigated Ground Becomes an Enclosure
subchannels.scene_or_process: Flow crosses receptive ground, gathers in a protected garden-space, and produces increase.
subchannels.active_motifs: flowing or streaming movement (`quranic:root_000240:B001/m01`); tree-covered garden enclosure (`quranic:root_000266:B003/m01`); soft fertile earth (`quranic:root_000025:B002/m01`); increase and growth (`quranic:root_000657:B001/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 48:5 `تجري` and `جنات` (ج ر ي; ج ن ن); 48:4 `الأرض` and `ليزدادوا` (ء ر ض; ز ي د), with `الأرض` again at 48:7.
subchannels.synthesis: The promised garden is the bounded receiving zone of the released flow. Fertile ground, streaming water, and increase form one cultivation process, making the opening productive rather than merely penetrative.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: An aperture releases directed movement that becomes life-bearing flow and bounded growth.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 48:1 opens decisively, while 48:4-5 adds increase, gardens, and running rivers.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The opening is not only an achieved result; the lexical network renders it as an outlet whose released flow irrigates an enclosure.

parent_channels.name: P1: Covering as Shelter and Absolution

subchannels.name: Protective Cover
subchannels.scene_or_process: A covering encloses, conceals, and shields what lies beneath it.
subchannels.active_motifs: protective covering (`quranic:root_001096:B001/m01`); concealment within an enclosure (`quranic:root_000266:B001/m01`); protective shield (`quranic:root_000266:B008/m01`); covering something from view (`quranic:root_001307:B001/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 48:2 `ليغفر` and 48:11 `فاستغفر` (غ ف ر); 48:5 `جنات` (ج ن ن); 48:5 `نكفر` and 48:13 `كفر` (ك ف ر).
subchannels.synthesis: Forgiveness is materialized as a cover, while the garden root supplies both concealment and shielding. The scene protects an interior by interposing a layer between it and exposure.

subchannels.name: Covered Liability
subchannels.scene_or_process: An offense remains identifiable, but its harmful consequence is covered and removed from operation.
subchannels.active_motifs: sin or offense (`quranic:root_000521:B001/m01`); covering a sin and protecting its bearer from the effect (`quranic:root_001096:B002/m01`); erasing an offense by covering it (`quranic:root_001307:B009/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 48:2 `ذنبك` and `ليغفر` (ذ ن ب; غ ف ر); 48:5 `نكفر` (ك ف ر).
subchannels.synthesis: This is not the sheltering of an object but the neutralization of liability. The offense supplies the object, forgiveness supplies the protective operation, and expiation names the outcome in which the offense no longer governs the person's standing.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Covering can protect a vulnerable object or suppress the continuing effect of an offense.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 48:2 and 48:11 ask for forgiveness, while 48:5 describes expiation and garden enclosure.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Physical shelter and moral absolution are two operations of the same covering mechanism, but they differ in what is covered and what outcome is prevented.

parent_channels.name: P1: Descent, Stilling, and Secure Increase

subchannels.name: Descent Arrests Motion
subchannels.scene_or_process: Something is delivered downward into a moving system and makes its motion cease.
subchannels.active_motifs: descent and settling (`quranic:root_001492:B001/m01`); delivery from above (`quranic:root_001492:B002/m01`); cessation of motion (`quranic:root_000726:B001/m01`); source of comfort and stillness (`quranic:root_000726:B004/m01`); ship-stabilizing rudder (`quranic:root_000726:B008/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 48:4 `أنزل` and `السكينة` (ن ز ل; س ك ن).
subchannels.synthesis: The descended tranquility behaves as an inserted stabilizing force. The rudder resonance makes the operation concrete: stillness does not mean inactivity, but controlled movement after a corrective device has entered the system.

subchannels.name: A Secured Heart Accumulates
subchannels.scene_or_process: The stabilized interior receives trust and grows by addition rather than dispersal.
subchannels.active_motifs: security and trust of the heart (`quranic:root_000054:B001/m01`); heart as interior center (`quranic:root_001248:B001/m01`); increase and growth (`quranic:root_000657:B001/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 48:4 `المؤمنين`, `قلوبهم`, and `ليزدادوا إيمانا` (ء م ن; ق ل ب; ز ي د).
subchannels.synthesis: Security is the state produced by stilling, the heart is its receiving chamber, and increase is its outcome. Faith grows because the interior has first been made capable of retaining rather than losing what arrives.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A force arriving from above arrests agitation so that an interior can become secure and accumulate strength.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 48:4 places the descent of tranquility in believers' hearts so that faith may increase.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Tranquility is rendered as an active stabilizer, including the lexical image of a steering device that checks unstable motion.

parent_channels.name: P1: A Message Made Present

subchannels.name: Commissioned Testimony
subchannels.scene_or_process: A messenger enters as an authorized bearer whose testimony makes the reported matter present.
subchannels.active_motifs: messenger and conveyed message (`quranic:root_000563:B002/m01`); presence as witness (`quranic:root_000822:B001/m01`); knowledgeable testimony (`quranic:root_000822:B002/m01`); tongue functioning as witness (`quranic:root_000822:B005/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 48:8 `أرسلناك` and `شاهدا` (ر س ل; ش ه د).
subchannels.synthesis: Commission and testimony are mutually completing roles. The messenger carries the report, and the witness register converts that report from remote information into something authoritatively present before its hearers.

subchannels.name: Advance Signs Produce Response
subchannels.scene_or_process: Initial signs announce an approaching outcome, opening either joy or caution before the event arrives.
subchannels.active_motifs: news that opens the skin with joy (`quranic:root_000120:B005/m01`); first appearances or advance signs (`quranic:root_000120:B007/m01`); warning that awakens caution (`quranic:root_001488:B001/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 48:8 `مبشرا` and `نذيرا` (ب ش ر; ن ذ ر).
subchannels.synthesis: Good news and warning are not merely opposite speech acts. Both are anticipatory mechanisms: one lets favorable consequence appear early as bodily joy, and the other lets danger appear early enough to activate restraint.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Communication becomes effective when a commissioned report is made present to an audience and produces anticipatory response.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 48:8 commissions the messenger as witness, bearer of good news, and warner.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Witnessing and announcement form one delivery event: testimony establishes presence, while news and warning make future consequence felt in advance.

parent_channels.name: P1: Allegiance as a Hand-to-Hand Transaction

subchannels.name: Exchange Sealed by Hand
subchannels.scene_or_process: Two parties enact an exchange through hand contact and place the transfer under covenantal protection.
subchannels.active_motifs: sale or exchange (`quranic:root_000169:B001/m01`); obedience pledge (`quranic:root_000169:B003/m01`); submissively yielded hand (`quranic:root_001693:B006/m01`); hand-to-hand transfer (`quranic:root_001693:B007/m01`); protected covenant (`quranic:root_001055:B003/m01`); sale warranty and liability (`quranic:root_001055:B006/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 48:10 `يبايعونك`, `يبايعون`, `يد`, and `عاهد` (ب ي ع; ي د ي; ع ه د).
subchannels.synthesis: The pledge is simultaneously submission and exchange. Hand contact performs the transfer, while the covenant and warranty motifs assign continuing liability to the one who has entered it.

subchannels.name: Fulfillment or Unraveling
subchannels.scene_or_process: The binding can be maintained to completion or loosened like a woven cord, with the consequence returning to the responsible party.
subchannels.active_motifs: unraveling a cord or weave (`quranic:root_001547:B001/m01`); breaking a confirmed covenant (`quranic:root_001547:B002/m01`); full completion and fulfillment (`quranic:root_001669:B001/m01`); wage or reward (`quranic:root_000015:B001/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 48:10 `نكث`, `ينكث`, `أوفى`, and `أجرا` (ن ك ث; و ف ي; ء ج ر).
subchannels.synthesis: Breach is a mechanical undoing of what hand contact bound; fulfillment carries the same structure to completion. Reward is therefore not detached compensation but the return attached to keeping the transfer intact.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A binding transfer is enacted through hand contact and remains valid only through protected fulfillment.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 48:10 describes pledging through the hand, breach, fulfillment, and reward.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Allegiance takes the structure of a sale, including transfer, warranty, liability, and the possibility that its binding weave may be undone.

parent_channels.name: P1: The Household Horizon of Return

subchannels.name: Inhabited Place of Return
subchannels.scene_or_process: Kin inhabit a familiar dwelling that remains oriented toward the travelers' return.
subchannels.active_motifs: kin and household (`quranic:root_000064:B001/m01`); inhabited familiar place (`quranic:root_000064:B004/m01`); dwelling (`quranic:root_000726:B002/m01`); resident household (`quranic:root_000726:B003/m01`); return or reversal of departure (`quranic:root_001248:B005/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 48:11 `أهلونا` (ء ه ل); 48:12 `ينقلب` and `أهليهم` (ق ل ب; ء ه ل); the dwelling root occurs as `السكينة` at 48:4 (س ك ن).
subchannels.synthesis: Household, dwelling, and return form one spatial relation: the family is not only a group but the inhabited terminus toward which movement can reverse. The heart-root's return sense makes the interior judgment about non-return also a directional act.

subchannels.name: Vacancy Produced by Non-return
subchannels.scene_or_process: Those who remain imagine a permanent absence, converting staying into the production of an empty home.
subchannels.active_motifs: empty or abandoned home (`quranic:root_000004:B003/m01`); staying without departure (`quranic:root_000004:B006/m01`); barren or empty dwelling (`quranic:root_000164:B003/m01`); those remaining behind (`quranic:root_000433:B003/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 48:12 `أبدا` and `بورا` (ء ب د; ب و ر); 48:11 `المخلفون` (خ ل ف).
subchannels.synthesis: Permanent non-return hollows out the expected destination. The ones who stay behind preserve their own location, but their supposition turns the travelers' households into abandoned space and exposes staying as a morally barren condition.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A household is constituted by expected return; when return is denied, habitation flips into vacancy and staying becomes abandonment.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 48:11 names families left behind, and 48:12 imagines that the messenger and believers will never return to them.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The false prediction does more than anticipate death; it lexically empties the dwelling before the travelers' fate is known.

parent_channels.name: P1: Voiced Exterior and Reworked Interior

subchannels.name: The Vocal Surface
subchannels.scene_or_process: The tongue gives audible form to a claim and places it before another party.
subchannels.active_motifs: tongue as speech organ (`quranic:root_001355:B001/m01`); language or articulated speech (`quranic:root_001355:B006/m01`); voiced utterance (`quranic:root_001272:B001/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 48:11 `سيقول`, `يقولون`, and `بألسنتهم` (ق و ل; ل س ن).
subchannels.synthesis: The claim has a clear delivery apparatus: saying supplies the utterance and the tongue supplies its audible exterior. Its coherence as speech does not establish correspondence with the interior that produced it.

subchannels.name: The Decorated Inner Model
subchannels.scene_or_process: An unvoiced thought is turned into a pleasing internal picture and stabilized as a harmful supposition.
subchannels.active_motifs: unvoiced inner saying (`quranic:root_001272:B012/m01`); heart as interior center (`quranic:root_001248:B001/m01`); turning or reversing a thing (`quranic:root_001248:B004/m01`); decorating and improving appearance (`quranic:root_000660:B002/m01`); uncertain supposition (`quranic:root_000969:B003/m01`); harmful suspicion (`quranic:root_000969:B005/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 48:11 `قلوبهم` and 48:12 `قلوبكم` (ق ل ب); 48:12 `زين` and `ظننتم` (ز ي ن; ظ ن ن); the saying root occurs at 48:11 as `سيقول` and `يقولون` (ق و ل).
subchannels.synthesis: The interior does not merely omit the tongue's claim. It turns the expected outcome, decorates that reversal until it appears plausible, and holds the result as suspicion. The surface lie and the inner model are thus distinct operations.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Speech can present one account outwardly while the heart silently constructs, decorates, and reverses another.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 48:11 contrasts what tongues say with what hearts do not contain, and 48:12 exposes the decorated supposition within.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The conflict is not simply speech versus belief; the inner account is an actively edited representation.

parent_channels.name: P1: Encirclement, Exclusion, and Combustion

subchannels.name: The Adverse Turn Closes Around
subchannels.scene_or_process: Harm returns in a circuit until the affected party is enclosed by the very reversal it expected for others.
subchannels.active_motifs: circulation or enclosure (`quranic:root_000499:B001/m01`); encircling bad turn or defeat (`quranic:root_000499:B004/m01`); harmful outcome (`quranic:root_000755:B002/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 48:6 `السوء` and `دائرة السوء` (س و ء; د و ر).
subchannels.synthesis: The evil supposition becomes a circular outcome rather than a linear blow. Its return encloses the supposer, making reversal itself the mechanism of judgment.

subchannels.name: Expulsion into an Ignited State
subchannels.scene_or_process: Wrath removes the object from favor, and the resulting exterior is figured as ruin and sustained ignition.
subchannels.active_motifs: wrath (`quranic:root_001092:B001/m01`); expulsion from good (`quranic:root_001359:B001/m01`); ruin (`quranic:root_000164:B001/m01`); blazing fire (`quranic:root_000708:B001/m01`); ignition of war or evil (`quranic:root_000708:B002/m01`); furnace pit (`quranic:root_000708:B009/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 48:6 `غضب` and `لعنهم` (غ ض ب; ل ع ن); 48:12 `بورا` (ب و ر); 48:13 `سعيرا` (س ع ر).
subchannels.synthesis: Wrath and curse perform the exclusion, ruin names the stripped condition, and the blaze gives that condition a material environment. The furnace image makes destructive consequence an enclosing destination rather than a momentary flash.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Adverse judgment closes around its object, expels it from protection, and exposes it to destructive heat.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 48:6 describes the evil turn, wrath, and curse, while 48:12-13 moves through ruin to blazing fire.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The sequence spatializes judgment as a tightening circuit followed by removal into an ignited exterior.

parent_channels.name: P2: Mobilization, Contact, and Recoil

subchannels.name: Summons Launches Following
subchannels.scene_or_process: A call raises a group into action, releases departure, and draws followers into the same movement.
subchannels.active_motifs: summons or call (`quranic:root_000478:B001/m01`); rising to an undertaking (`quranic:root_001273:B003/m01`); following (`quranic:root_000175:B001/m01`); catching up with a leader (`quranic:root_000175:B002/m01`); launch or unimpeded departure (`quranic:root_000946:B003/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 48:16 `ستدعون` and `قوم` (د ع و; ق و م); 48:15 `انطلقتم`, `نتبعكم`, and `تتبعونا` (ط ل ق; ت ب ع).
subchannels.synthesis: The call is a kinetic event. It makes the group-root perform its latent rising action, opens a departure path, and tests whether those behind will genuinely enter and maintain the leader's trajectory.

subchannels.name: Contact Resolves as Combat or Submission
subchannels.scene_or_process: The advancing bodies meet an opposing force, and contact resolves through fighting, surrender, or obedient response.
subchannels.active_motifs: mutual combat (`quranic:root_001200:B011/m01`); peace or surrender in contrast with war (`quranic:root_000737:B004/m01`); obedience (`quranic:root_000956:B001/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 48:16 `تقاتلونهم`, `يسلمون`, and `تطيعوا` (ق ت ل; س ل م; ط و ع).
subchannels.synthesis: Combat and surrender are alternative outcomes of the same encounter, while obedience governs the summoned party's relation to entering it. The scene distinguishes resolution at the opposing line from compliance behind it.

subchannels.name: Remaining Behind Becomes Reversal
subchannels.scene_or_process: Refusal leaves a party behind and then turns movement backward at the point of pressure.
subchannels.active_motifs: those remaining behind (`quranic:root_000433:B003/m01`); turning away (`quranic:root_001684:B007/m01`); turning the back in retreat (`quranic:root_000458:B003/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 48:15 `المخلفون` and 48:16 `المخلفين` (خ ل ف); 48:16 `تتولوا` and 48:22 `يولون` (و ل ي); 48:22 `الأدبار` (د ب ر).
subchannels.synthesis: Being left behind is not only a location in the marching order. Under renewed summons it becomes an orientation: refusal turns the body away, and military retreat makes that orientation visible as the exposed back.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A summons reorganizes bodies by launching them toward an encounter, resolving contact, or exposing reversal and refusal.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 48:15-17 stages departure, following, summons, combat, surrender, and obedience, while 48:22 supplies retreat.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The people named by the summons carry a latent rising function, so mobilization begins before combat in the conversion of a stationary group into an undertaking.

parent_channels.name: P2: Impairment as Blocked Navigation

subchannels.name: Sight Loss Removes the Track
subchannels.scene_or_process: Loss of sight expands into loss of insight and then into terrain without a readable route.
subchannels.active_motifs: physical blindness (`quranic:root_001049:B001/m01`); blindness of insight (`quranic:root_001049:B002/m01`); trackless land (`quranic:root_001049:B006/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 48:17 `الأعمى` (ع م ي).
subchannels.synthesis: A bodily limitation becomes a spatial mechanism. What the eye cannot distinguish becomes a landscape without a track, while the insight sense transfers the same obstruction into judgment.

subchannels.name: Gait and Resolve Are Constricted
subchannels.scene_or_process: A crooked or weakened gait slows, stops, and narrows the route available to the moving person.
subchannels.active_motifs: lameness (`quranic:root_000997:B001/m01`); crooked path (`quranic:root_000997:B002/m01`); stopping or delay (`quranic:root_000997:B003/m01`); illness (`quranic:root_001415:B001/m01`); weakened motion or resolve (`quranic:root_001415:B004/m01`); constriction or strait (`quranic:root_000304:B002/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 48:17 `الأعرج`, `المريض`, and `حرج` (ع ر ج; م ر ض; ح ر ج).
subchannels.synthesis: Lameness bends the route and interrupts its traversal; illness reduces the mover's force; constriction names the narrowed field that results. The surface exemptions are thereby reframed as distinct failures in a movement system.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Bodily limitation is rendered as loss of route, interruption of gait, and constriction of available movement.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 48:17 names blindness, lameness, illness, and the removal of constraint.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The exemptions form a navigation scene: blindness removes the track, lameness bends or stops the path, and illness weakens the capacity to continue.

parent_channels.name: P2: The Recognized Pledge and Its Return

subchannels.name: Assembly Beneath the Tree
subchannels.scene_or_process: Participants gather in a subordinated position, pledge allegiance, and become the objects of acceptance.
subchannels.active_motifs: obedience pledge (`quranic:root_000169:B003/m01`); tree (`quranic:root_000777:B001/m01`); position beneath (`quranic:root_000177:B001/m01`); acceptance or approval (`quranic:root_000569:B001/m01`); satisfied acceptance (`quranic:root_000569:B002/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 48:18 `رضي`, `يبايعونك`, `تحت`, and `الشجرة` (ر ض و; ب ي ع; ت ح ت; ش ج ر).
subchannels.synthesis: The tree supplies the assembly's fixed setting, beneath supplies its spatial submission, and the pledge supplies its social act. Acceptance turns the whole configured scene into a recognized relation.

subchannels.name: Interior Knowledge Returns as Stability and Opening
subchannels.scene_or_process: Knowledge reaches the heart, a stabilizer descends, and the recognized act returns as reward and opened outcome.
subchannels.active_motifs: knowing (`quranic:root_001040:B001/m01`); heart as interior center (`quranic:root_001248:B001/m01`); delivery from above (`quranic:root_001492:B002/m01`); cessation of motion (`quranic:root_000726:B001/m01`); source of comfort and stillness (`quranic:root_000726:B004/m01`); reward as return (`quranic:root_000209:B002/m01`); victory or opening (`quranic:root_001124:B004/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 48:18 `فعلم`, `قلوبهم`, `فأنزل`, `السكينة`, `وأثابهم`, and `فتحا` (ع ل م; ق ل ب; ن ز ل; س ك ن; ث و ب; ف ت ح).
subchannels.synthesis: The outer pledge is answered through an inner sequence. Knowledge identifies what the hearts contain, descent stabilizes that interior, reward returns the act's value, and the near opening externalizes the settled relation.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A witnessed act of allegiance is inwardly recognized, stabilized, and answered by a returning benefit.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 48:18 joins the pledge under the tree to divine knowledge, tranquility, and a near opening.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Acceptance is not only an evaluation of the pledge; it is the hinge that converts a visible assembly into an inwardly known state and then into returned outcome.

parent_channels.name: P2: Restrained Force and Enclosed Capacity

subchannels.name: Hands Arrested Before Contact
subchannels.scene_or_process: A capable hand reaches the edge of action but is checked before force passes into another body.
subchannels.active_motifs: palm (`quranic:root_001308:B001/m01`); restraint (`quranic:root_001308:B002/m01`); hand (`quranic:root_001693:B001/m01`); force or capacity of the hand (`quranic:root_001693:B002/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 48:20 `كف` and `أيدي` (ك ف ف; ي د ي); 48:24 `كف`, `أيديهم`, and `أيديكم` (ك ف ف; ي د ي).
subchannels.synthesis: The palm gives the force an embodied endpoint, and restraint arrests that endpoint before impact. The hand remains capable, so non-contact appears as controlled power rather than absence of power.

subchannels.name: Capacity Held Within an Enclosure
subchannels.scene_or_process: Power surrounds an object, keeps it under protective possession, and closes it within the range of future action.
subchannels.active_motifs: closure or containment (`quranic:root_001308:B003/m01`); encirclement (`quranic:root_000372:B001/m01`); protective care (`quranic:root_000372:B002/m01`); encompassing knowledge or possession (`quranic:root_000372:B004/m01`); capability (`quranic:root_001205:B003/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 48:20 `كف` (ك ف ف); 48:21 `أحاط` and `قديرا` (ح و ط; ق د ر).
subchannels.synthesis: Encompassing does not merely surround; it combines possession, knowledge, and protective custody. Capability is therefore stored inside a controlled perimeter until its time of manifestation.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Effective power may be fully present while held inside a boundary that prevents premature contact.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 48:20 and 48:24 describe restrained hands, while 48:21 describes what is encompassed by power.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Restraint is not impotence: palm, hand-force, enclosure, care, and capacity depict force as deliberately contained and preserved.

parent_channels.name: P2: Forms Held Against Substitution

subchannels.name: A Spoken Directive Resists Editing
subchannels.scene_or_process: An uttered claim attempts to alter a prior directive, but the word remains unavailable for substitution.
subchannels.active_motifs: voiced utterance (`quranic:root_001272:B001/m01`); substitution (`quranic:root_000095:B001/m01`); change or replacement (`quranic:root_000095:B002/m01`); word as articulated unit (`quranic:root_001316:B002/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 48:15 `سيقول`, `يريدون أن يبدلوا`, `كلام`, `لن تتبعونا`, and `قال` (ق و ل; ب د ل; ك ل م).
subchannels.synthesis: The later speech proposes an edit to an already operative word. The substitution root exposes the attempt as replacement rather than interpretation, while the word-root preserves the directive as a bounded form.

subchannels.name: An Established Course Resists Rerouting
subchannels.scene_or_process: A course laid down through prior events continues without being exchanged for another route.
subchannels.active_motifs: established path or custom (`quranic:root_000750:B001/m01`); smooth continuous course (`quranic:root_000750:B002/m01`); substitution (`quranic:root_000095:B001/m01`); change or replacement (`quranic:root_000095:B002/m01`); time or peoples passed before (`quranic:root_000436:B003/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 48:23 `سنة`, `خلت`, and `تبديلا` (س ن ن; خ ل و; ب د ل).
subchannels.synthesis: Precedent is rendered as a continuous path whose prior traversal gives it form. Denial of substitution means that the course cannot be rerouted when it reaches the present encounter.

subchannels.name: A Word Fastened as Guard
subchannels.scene_or_process: A verbal form adheres to its bearers as a binding obligation and protective barrier.
subchannels.active_motifs: word as articulated unit (`quranic:root_001316:B002/m01`); lasting adhesion (`quranic:root_001354:B001/m01`); binding obligation (`quranic:root_001354:B002/m01`); protective barrier (`quranic:root_001677:B001/m01`); self-protection or piety (`quranic:root_001677:B002/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 48:26 `ألزمهم`, `كلمة`, and `التقوى` (ل ز م; ك ل م; و ق ي).
subchannels.synthesis: The word is preserved here not by remaining external but by being fastened to persons. Adhesion converts speech into obligation, and the protection-root makes that obligation function as a guard around conduct.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A valid form remains effective by resisting replacement, whether it is spoken, traveled, or fastened as an obligation.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 48:15 rejects changing God's word, 48:23 denies change in an established way, and 48:26 binds the word of protection.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Speech, precedent, and obligation share the same preservation mechanism even though one is uttered, one is traversed, and one adheres to persons.

parent_channels.name: P2: Regulation at the Sacred Threshold

subchannels.name: Blocked at the Precinct Boundary
subchannels.scene_or_process: A boundary is made inviolable, access is obstructed, and a gathered object remains detained before it.
subchannels.active_motifs: sacred spatial boundary (`quranic:root_000313:B003/m01`); inviolable right (`quranic:root_000313:B006/m01`); blocking or diversion (`quranic:root_000848:B001/m01`); barrier like a mountain (`quranic:root_000848:B005/m01`); detention (`quranic:root_001038:B002/m01`); gathering around a fixed point (`quranic:root_001038:B004/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 48:25 `صدوكم`, `المسجد الحرام`, and `معكوفا` (ص د د; ح ر م; ع ك ف).
subchannels.synthesis: Sacredness supplies the protected perimeter, diversion supplies the obstructing action, and detention gathers the offering at the threshold. The mountain-barrier resonance gives the prohibition a material thickness.

subchannels.name: Offering Reaches Its Place of Release
subchannels.scene_or_process: A consecrated offering is directed toward a destination where obligation falls due and prohibition dissolves.
subchannels.active_motifs: sacrificial offering sent to the sanctuary (`quranic:root_001583:B005/m01`); reaching a destination (`quranic:root_000151:B001/m01`); arrival or settling place (`quranic:root_000351:B002/m01`); dissolution of prohibition (`quranic:root_000351:B003/m01`); obligation falling due when the offering reaches its place (`quranic:root_000351:B004/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 48:25 `الهدي`, `يبلغ`, and `محله` (ه د ي; ب ل غ; ح ل ل).
subchannels.synthesis: The offering has its own authorized trajectory. Reaching is not merely locomotion: arrival activates the due act and changes the offering's legal state from detained and prohibited to released.

subchannels.name: Authorized Entry Changes Bodily State
subchannels.scene_or_process: Protected entrants cross the boundary and display release from consecration by shaving or shortening the hair.
subchannels.active_motifs: entry (`quranic:root_000464:B001/m01`); consecrated ritual state (`quranic:root_000313:B004/m01`); dissolution of prohibition (`quranic:root_000351:B003/m01`); shaving (`quranic:root_000350:B002/m01`); shortening hair (`quranic:root_001231:B003/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 48:27 `لتدخلن`, `المسجد الحرام`, `محلقين`, and `مقصرين` (د خ ل; ح ر م; ح ل ق; ق ص ر); 48:25 `محله` (ح ل ل).
subchannels.synthesis: Entry and bodily alteration are coordinated threshold events. Crossing the sacred boundary is completed by visible release from the prior ritual state, with shaving and shortening marking two authorized forms of that transition.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Entry into sacred space is governed by boundaries, detained offerings, arrival at an appointed place, and release from a prior bodily state.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 48:25 blocks access and detains the offering, while 48:27 promises secure entry with shaved or shortened hair.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The sanctuary is not a simple inside/outside division; it is a regulated threshold where bodies and offerings undergo different authorization sequences.

parent_channels.name: P2: Protected Interior and Differentiated Contact

subchannels.name: Concealed Human Interior
subchannels.scene_or_process: Persons remain unseen within an interior that receives entry into protective mercy.
subchannels.active_motifs: belly or interior (`quranic:root_000128:B001/m01`); hidden interior (`quranic:root_000128:B002/m01`); tender protective mercy (`quranic:root_000552:B001/m01`); womb (`quranic:root_000552:B003/m01`); entry (`quranic:root_000464:B001/m01`); men (`quranic:root_000546:B002/m01`); women (`quranic:root_001500:B001/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 48:24 `ببطن` (ب ط ن); 48:25 `رجال`, `ونساء`, `يدخل`, and `رحمته` (ر ج ل; ن س و; د خ ل; ر ح م).
subchannels.synthesis: The belly-root spatializes the city's hidden interior, while the womb sense of mercy makes protection generative and enclosing. Men and women are the concealed occupants whose unknown presence governs whether force may enter.

subchannels.name: Separation Prevents Crushing Contact
subchannels.scene_or_process: Hidden populations are distinguished before foot-pressure can produce bodily harm and an attached stain.
subchannels.active_motifs: separation and distinction (`quranic:root_000659:B001/m01`); footfall or trampling (`quranic:root_001659:B001/m01`); crushing pressure (`quranic:root_001659:B003/m01`); calamity striking (`quranic:root_000889:B004/m01`); stain or blame (`quranic:root_000999:B003/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 48:25 `تطؤوهم`, `فتصيبكم`, `معرة`, and `لو تزيلوا` (و ط ء; ص و ب; ع ر ر; ز ي ل).
subchannels.synthesis: Separation is a precondition for legitimate contact. Without it, the foot becomes a crushing instrument, the strike reaches unknown believers, and the resulting harm adheres to the actors as a stain.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A concealed interior remains protected when indistinguishable persons are separated before force can strike them.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 48:24 names the interior of Mecca, and 48:25 describes unknown believing men and women, possible trampling, separation, mercy, and punishment.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The city's interior and the womb-like register of mercy make hidden persons components of a protected interior rather than incidental obstacles.

parent_channels.name: P2: Heated Impulse and Descended Stabilization

subchannels.name: Protective Heat Becomes Agitation
subchannels.scene_or_process: A guarding impulse intensifies into pride, fever, and unstable movement inside the heart.
subchannels.active_motifs: heat (`quranic:root_000358:B001/m01`); protective prohibition (`quranic:root_000358:B002/m01`); heated pride or anger (`quranic:root_000358:B003/m01`); feverish intensity (`quranic:root_000358:B008/m01`); volatile impulse (`quranic:root_000271:B002/m01`); agitation after stillness (`quranic:root_000271:B005/m01`); heart as interior center (`quranic:root_001248:B001/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 48:26 `قلوبهم`, `الحمية`, and `حمية الجاهلية` (ق ل ب; ح م ي; ج ه ل).
subchannels.synthesis: The heat begins with a protective boundary but overheats into pride. Ignorant volatility destabilizes the heart, so a function that could guard instead produces oscillation and reactive excess.

subchannels.name: A Stabilizer Is Delivered Into Motion
subchannels.scene_or_process: A corrective force descends into the unstable system, checks its motion, and restores comfort and steering.
subchannels.active_motifs: delivery from above (`quranic:root_001492:B002/m01`); cessation of motion (`quranic:root_000726:B001/m01`); source of comfort and stillness (`quranic:root_000726:B004/m01`); ship-stabilizing rudder (`quranic:root_000726:B008/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 48:26 `فأنزل` and `سكينته` (ن ز ل; س ك ن).
subchannels.synthesis: Descended tranquility enters the same field that heat has disturbed. The rudder resonance clarifies the contrast: stabilization preserves directed movement while preventing the system from being driven by every surge.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Volatile interior heat is countered by an arriving force that arrests oscillation and restores controlled motion.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 48:26 places heated zeal in the unbelievers' hearts and sets against it tranquility sent down upon the messenger and believers.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Protective zeal contains both guard and fever, while tranquility answers it as a steering mechanism rather than as mere passivity.

parent_channels.name: P2: Vision Verified as Access and Manifestation

subchannels.name: The Seen Promise Is Made True
subchannels.scene_or_process: A represented scene is shown, tested against truth, and fulfilled as an actual event.
subchannels.active_motifs: dream (`quranic:root_000531:B003/m01`); making visible (`quranic:root_000531:B012/m01`); fulfilling or verifying a dream (`quranic:root_000852:B004/m01`); truth (`quranic:root_000347:B001/m01`); establishing or showing truth (`quranic:root_000347:B005/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 48:27 `صدق`, `الرؤيا`, and `بالحق` (ص د ق; ر ء ي; ح ق ق).
subchannels.synthesis: The vision begins as a represented scene, but truth acts on it as verification. Fulfillment converts visibility from an inward image into an event whose correspondence can be publicly established.

subchannels.name: The Threshold Becomes Near and Traversable
subchannels.scene_or_process: Obstruction is removed, an opening approaches, and protected bodies pass through the threshold.
subchannels.active_motifs: opened threshold (`quranic:root_001124:B001/m01`); insight or unblocking (`quranic:root_001124:B008/m01`); entry (`quranic:root_000464:B001/m01`); nearness (`quranic:root_001212:B001/m01`); event becoming due or close (`quranic:root_001212:B002/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 48:27 `لتدخلن`, `قريبا`, and `فتحا` (د خ ل; ق ر ب; ف ت ح).
subchannels.synthesis: The opening is the operational form of verification: it removes the obstruction that separates image from traversal. Nearness compresses the interval until entry becomes possible.

subchannels.name: Guidance Becomes Publicly Ascendant
subchannels.scene_or_process: Guidance leads from the front, truth is manifested, and witnessing establishes the result before others.
subchannels.active_motifs: guidance (`quranic:root_001583:B001/m01`); leading from the front (`quranic:root_001583:B003/m01`); truth (`quranic:root_000347:B001/m01`); manifestation (`quranic:root_000970:B001/m01`); ascent or prevailing (`quranic:root_000970:B007/m01`); knowledgeable testimony (`quranic:root_000822:B002/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 48:28 `بالهدى`, `دين الحق`, `ليظهره`, and `شهيدا` (ه د ي; ح ق ق; ظ ه ر; ش ه د).
subchannels.synthesis: Guidance supplies direction, manifestation supplies visibility, and ascent supplies the changed public relation. Witnessing closes the process by making the now-visible truth answerable to testimony.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: What is first represented becomes true by turning into traversable access and then public appearance.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 48:27 moves from a true vision to secure entry and a near opening, and 48:28 moves from guidance to the manifestation of the true religion.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Verification is not limited to correspondence between dream and event; it progressively unblocks a threshold and makes guidance publicly ascendant.

parent_channels.name: P2: Hardened Edge and Womb-like Bond

subchannels.name: The Outward Edge Is Tightened
subchannels.scene_or_process: A boundary-facing group draws its parts together and presents concentrated force.
subchannels.active_motifs: tying or tightening a knot (`quranic:root_000782:B001/m01`); force and solidity (`quranic:root_000782:B002/m01`); mutual support (`quranic:root_000027:B001/m01`); disbelief or covering (`quranic:root_001307:B003/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 48:29 `أشداء` and `الكفار` (ش د د; ك ف ر); the support root occurs as `فآزره` later in the same ayah (ء ز ر).
subchannels.synthesis: Severity is not diffuse aggression but consolidated structure. Knotting and mutual support make the outward edge capable of bearing pressure as one solid formation.

subchannels.name: The Interior Is Joined by Kin-like Mercy
subchannels.scene_or_process: Those within the boundary are connected across their intervals by a tender relation modeled on kinship and womb.
subchannels.active_motifs: tender mercy (`quranic:root_000552:B001/m01`); kinship bond (`quranic:root_000552:B002/m01`); womb (`quranic:root_000552:B003/m01`); interval between parties (`quranic:root_000170:B002/m01`); connective bond across an interval (`quranic:root_000170:B003/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 48:29 `رحماء` and `بينهم` (ر ح م; ب ي ن).
subchannels.synthesis: Mercy does not weaken the formation's interior; it joins it. The womb and kinship senses give the relation an enclosing origin, while the between-root turns separation into a connective interval.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A community distributes force differently across its boundary and its interior.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 48:29 describes severity toward unbelievers and mercy among the believers.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Outward firmness takes the mechanics of a tightened knot, while inward mercy takes the anatomy of kinship and womb.

parent_channels.name: P2: Bodily Lowering Leaves a Visible Mark

subchannels.name: The Body Lowers Itself
subchannels.scene_or_process: Head and body bend downward in a repeated act of humility and submission.
subchannels.active_motifs: bending or lowering the head (`quranic:root_000594:B001/m01`); humility (`quranic:root_000594:B003/m01`); prostration and submission (`quranic:root_000675:B001/m01`); lowering the head (`quranic:root_000675:B004/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 48:29 `ركعا` and `سجدا` (ر ك ع; س ج د).
subchannels.synthesis: Bowing initiates the downward orientation and prostration completes it. Humility is therefore embodied as a directional process rather than left as an unobservable attitude.

subchannels.name: Repetition Becomes Recognizable Trace
subchannels.scene_or_process: Contact leaves a residual mark on the face, allowing prior bodily action to be seen afterward.
subchannels.active_motifs: prostrating limbs and their trace (`quranic:root_000675:B003/m01`); remaining trace (`quranic:root_000011:B003/m01`); recognizable mark (`quranic:root_000764:B004/m01`); face (`quranic:root_001630:B001/m01`); sight or recognition (`quranic:root_000531:B001/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 48:29 `تراهم`, `سيماهم`, `وجوههم`, `أثر`, and `السجود` (ر ء ي; س و م; و ج ه; ء ث ر; س ج د).
subchannels.synthesis: The body's lowered movement survives as a residue after the movement ends. Face supplies the display surface, trace supplies persistence, and sight turns that persistence into recognizable evidence.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Repeated submission alters posture and leaves a trace by which the body's orientation can be recognized.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 48:29 depicts bowing, prostration, faces, and the visible trace of prostration.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The mark is not an added emblem; it is the remaining physical effect of a repeated directional movement.

parent_channels.name: P2: Reinforced Crop and Divided Response

subchannels.name: Shoots Reinforce Into an Upright Crop
subchannels.scene_or_process: Covered seed produces shoots that support one another, thicken, straighten, and stand upon load-bearing stems.
subchannels.active_motifs: sowing and cultivation (`quranic:root_000630:B001/m01`); cultivator covering seed (`quranic:root_001307:B008/m01`); shoots emerging around a root (`quranic:root_000793:B001/m01`); mutual plant reinforcement (`quranic:root_000027:B004/m01`); thickening after thinness (`quranic:root_001099:B001/m01`); straightening into full formation (`quranic:root_000766:B002/m01`); standing or settling firmly (`quranic:root_000766:B003/m01`); stem or leg bearing the load (`quranic:root_000762:B003/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 48:29 `زرع`, `شطأه`, `فآزره`, `فاستغلظ`, `فاستوى`, `سوقه`, and `الكفار` (ز ر ع; ش ط ء; ء ز ر; غ ل ظ; س و ي; س و ق; ك ف ر).
subchannels.synthesis: Growth is a cooperative mechanical sequence. Emergence adds shoots, shoots reinforce the center, thickening increases load-bearing capacity, and straightening settles the crop upright on its stems. The seed-covering sense places hidden cultivation at the start of the visible result.

subchannels.name: Mature Visibility Polarizes Observers
subchannels.scene_or_process: The completed crop pleases those who cultivate it while provoking inward heat in those positioned against it.
subchannels.active_motifs: visual pleasure and wonder (`quranic:root_000984:B003/m01`); inward vexation (`quranic:root_001121:B001/m01`); flare of heat (`quranic:root_001121:B003/m01`); disbelief or covering (`quranic:root_001307:B003/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 48:29 `يعجب`, `ليغيظ`, and `الكفار` (ع ج ب; غ ي ظ; ك ف ر).
subchannels.synthesis: The crop is one object but produces opposite readings. Cultivators recognize successful formation and are pleased; opponents experience the same visibility as inward heat. The covering root sharpens the reversal between the one who helps hidden seed emerge and the one who rejects what has emerged.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Healthy emergence consolidates through mutual support until its mature visibility produces opposite responses in different observers.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 48:29 describes the shoot, reinforcement, thickening, upright stem, farmers' wonder, and unbelievers' vexation.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The covering root changes roles across the scene: it names both the cultivator who covers seed and the unbeliever agitated by the crop's visible maturity.

parent_channels.name: S1. P1: Mutually Reinforced Host
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A gathered host becomes effective through mutual support, honored aid, reinforcement, and opened victory.
parent_channels.active_motifs: gathered mutually supporting host (`quranic:root_000264:B001/m01`); aid and support (`quranic:root_001510:B001/m01`); aid joined to honor and defense (`quranic:root_001007:B001/m01`); reinforcement (`quranic:root_001008:B004/m01`); victory or conquest (`quranic:root_001124:B004/m01`).
parent_channels.ayah_anchors: 48:4 and 48:7 `جنود` (ج ن د); 48:3 `وينصرك` and `نصرا` (ن ص ر); 48:9 `وتعزروه` (ع ز ر); 48:3 `عزيزا` and 48:7 `عزيزا` (ع ز ز); 48:1 `فتحا` (ف ت ح).
parent_channels.synthesis: The host is not a mere collection of units; its lexical image already implies gathered mutual support. Aid, defensive honor, and reinforcement supply the forces that hold the host together, while opened victory is the outcome of that coordinated structure.

parent_channels.name: S2. Whole Surah: Drawing and Storing Water
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A stone-lined well is worked by pulley and bucket, then its potable water is transferred into portable and fixed containers for use.
parent_channels.active_motifs: well before or after lining (`quranic:root_001248:B007/m01`); stone lining that stabilizes a well (`quranic:root_000358:B011/m01`); rotating drawing pulley (`quranic:root_000143:B006/m01`); large full bucket (`quranic:root_000521:B007/m01`); single-handled water bucket (`quranic:root_000737:B011/m01`); waterskin for carrying drawn water (`quranic:root_001212:B009/m01`); large storage jar (`quranic:root_001251:B003/m01`); sweet potable water (`quranic:root_000994:B001/m01`); water sufficient to sustain life (`quranic:root_001533:B008/m01`).
parent_channels.ayah_anchors: 48:2 `ذنبك` (ذ ن ب); 48:9 `بكرة` (ب ك ر); 48:10 `نفسه` (ن ف س); 48:12 `ينقلب` (ق ل ب); 48:14 `ويعذب` (ع ذ ب); 48:15 `قليلا` (ق ل ل); 48:16 `يسلمون` (س ل م); 48:18 and 48:27 `قريبا` (ق ر ب); 48:26 `الحمية` (ح م ي).
parent_channels.synthesis: The cluster extends flowing water into a complete human provisioning system: secure the source, lift water, carry it, store it, and drink. It materially supports the surah's opened access and river-garden promise by showing provision not as decorative abundance but as water made reachable, containable, and life-sustaining.

parent_channels.name: S3. Whole Surah: Fitting and Controlling a Mount
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A prepared mount is padded, saddled, bridled, loaded, and controlled between restraint and accelerated travel.
parent_channels.active_motifs: strong horse prepared for riding or running (`quranic:root_000978:B002/m01`); bare wooden saddle-tree (`quranic:root_001029:B009/m01`); pad placed beneath the saddle (`quranic:root_001684:B011/m01`); fastening a saddle onto a she-camel (`quranic:root_000793:B003/m01`); bridle surrounding the jaws and checking movement (`quranic:root_000348:B006/m01`); extending the reins to increase speed (`quranic:root_000151:B007/m01`); load-bearing mount and carried equipment (`quranic:root_000970:B005/m01`); stirrup straps attached to saddles (`quranic:root_000762:B009/m01`).
parent_channels.ayah_anchors: 48:4 `حكيما` (ح ك م); 48:5 `عظيما` (ع ظ م); 48:13 `اعتدنا` (ع ت د); 48:16 `تتولوا` (و ل ي); 48:25 `يبلغ` (ب ل غ); 48:28 `ليظهره` (ظ ه ر); 48:29 `شطأه` and `سوقه` (ش ط ء; س و ق).
parent_channels.synthesis: Preparation becomes mobility only through fitted equipment: the saddle distributes weight, the pad protects the back, the bridle checks force, and the reins permit speed. This materializes the surah's summons and severe encounter as disciplined mobilization, in which effective power depends on controlled transport rather than unrestrained motion.

parent_channels.name: S4. Whole Surah: Nocking and Aiming a Bow
parent_channels.scene_or_process: The bow's limb and notch receive a nocked arrow, which is held on a target line until it reaches the intended mark.
parent_channels.active_motifs: curved limb of a bow (`quranic:root_000546:B009/m01`); bow tip beyond the string-notch (`quranic:root_000965:B007/m01`); arrow nock that receives the bowstring (`quranic:root_001188:B009/m01`); target or backstop behind the arrow (`quranic:root_000458:B018/m01`); aimed arrival at the target (`quranic:root_000889:B003/m01`).
parent_channels.ayah_anchors: 48:10 `فوق` (ف و ق); 48:22 `الأدبار` (د ب ر); 48:24 `أظفركم` (ظ ف ر); 48:25 `رجال` and `فتصيبكم` (ر ج ل; ص و ب).
parent_channels.synthesis: The motifs form one projectile mechanism from fitted string-contact to directed impact. This usefully pressures a reading of the surah's military power as indiscriminate: restrained hands and eventual combat are lexically accompanied by force whose efficacy depends on alignment, a defined target, and an intended hit.

parent_channels.name: S5. Whole Surah: Arrow Lots Divide a Camel Share
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Named and numbered gaming arrows allocate portions of a slaughtered camel, distinguishing winning shares from the losing lot.
parent_channels.active_motifs: completing the gamblers' camel-meat shares according to the arrow result (`quranic:root_000188:B006/m01`); gaming arrow named `عتاد` (`quranic:root_000978:B004/m01`); fifth arrow in the maysir set (`quranic:root_001533:B016/m01`); losing lot-arrow (`quranic:root_000458:B019/m01`); gambling victory that bars a rival from the hoped-for share (`quranic:root_000313:B007/m01`).
parent_channels.ayah_anchors: 48:2 `ويتم` (ت م م); 48:10 `نفسه` (ن ف س); 48:13 `اعتدنا` (ع ت د); 48:22 `الأدبار` (د ب ر); 48:25 and 48:27 `الحرام` (ح ر م).
parent_channels.synthesis: The scene is a concrete chance-allocation practice: the arrow set numbers claims, a cast produces a winner and loser, and the carcass is divided accordingly. It usefully pressures the surah's repeated victory, reward, and spoil language by supplying the rejected alternative model: its gains follow pledge, restraint, and obedience rather than the luck of a gaming lot.

parent_channels.name: S6. Whole Surah: Releasing, Grazing, and Corralling a Flock
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Sheep and other livestock are released into pasture, driven and gathered as a flock, then returned to a protective enclosure.
parent_channels.active_motifs: sheep and goats as a livestock class (`quranic:root_001109:B001/m01`); flock of sheep (`quranic:root_001674:B006/m01`); livestock enclosure of branches or stones (`quranic:root_000897:B003/m01`); gathering and circling a dispersed herd (`quranic:root_000372:B003/m01`); camels released toward pasture and water (`quranic:root_000946:B006/m01`); free grazing in pasture (`quranic:root_000764:B003/m01`); driving sheep or camels as a group (`quranic:root_000762:B001/m01`).
parent_channels.ayah_anchors: 48:6 `مصيرا` (ص ي ر); 48:9 `وتوقروه` (و ق ر); 48:15 `انطلقتم` and `مغانم` (ط ل ق; غ ن م), with `مغانم` again at 48:19-20; 48:21 `أحاط` (ح و ط); 48:29 `سيماهم` and `سوقه` (س و م; س و ق).
parent_channels.synthesis: The gain-root becomes a living flock that must be released, fed, directed, gathered, and sheltered. This reframes the surah's repeated spoils as managed pastoral wealth rather than inert property: acquisition creates custody, movement, and protection obligations.

parent_channels.name: S7. Whole Surah: Completing and Lining a Garment
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A final piece completes a tightly woven cloth, edges are sewn together, an inner lining is added, and the finished garment is wrapped around its wearer.
parent_channels.active_motifs: extra wool or hair that completes an unfinished weave (`quranic:root_000188:B007/m01`); tightly and soundly woven cloth (`quranic:root_000347:B010/m01`); thick edge or seam joining two panels (`quranic:root_000121:B006/m01`); garment lining beneath the outer surface (`quranic:root_000128:B003/m01`); completed garment or clothing (`quranic:root_000209:B003/m01`); wrapping oneself in a garment (`quranic:root_001163:B005/m01`).
parent_channels.ayah_anchors: 48:2 `ويتم` (ت م م); 48:18 `وأثابهم` (ث و ب); 48:24 `ببطن` and `بصيرا` (ب ط ن; ب ص ر); 48:27 `بالحق` (ح ق ق); 48:29 `فضلا` (ف ض ل).
parent_channels.synthesis: The covering is made through completion, tight weave, joined edges, and a protected interior surface. This materializes the surah's forgiveness and covenant integrity as constructed protection: a cover holds because its parts have been finished and joined, while breach resembles damage to an achieved fabric rather than a merely verbal lapse.

parent_channels.name: S8. Whole Surah: Nursing Illness Through Recovery and Relapse
parent_channels.scene_or_process: An illness intensifies and overcomes the patient, another person tends the sickbed, improvement begins, and recovery remains vulnerable to relapse.
parent_channels.active_motifs: illness becoming severe (`quranic:root_000151:B008/m01`); disease overpowering the patient (`quranic:root_001008:B009/m01`); nursing and attending a sick person (`quranic:root_001415:B003/m01`); recovery to health after wasting (`quranic:root_000152:B003/m01`); convalescent improvement (`quranic:root_001397:B012/m01`); relapse of illness or wound after improvement (`quranic:root_001096:B004/m01`).
parent_channels.ayah_anchors: 48:2 `ليغفر` (غ ف ر); 48:3 `عزيزا` (ع ز ز); 48:17 `المريض` (م ر ض); 48:25 `يبلغ` (ب ل غ); 48:29 `مثلهم` (م ث ل). The recovery motif's root ب ل ل is listed among the bundle's missing roots, so its surface anchor is unavailable.
parent_channels.synthesis: Illness appears as a changing social process rather than a fixed label: severity can rise, care is performed by another person, improvement can consolidate, and relapse can undo it. This usefully pressures a static reading of the exemption in 48:17 by showing why bodily incapacity requires temporal judgment and care, not assimilation to refusal or retreat.

parent_channels.name: S9. P1-P2: The Straight Path Broadens from One to Many
parent_channels.scene_or_process: P1 (48:2) places the messenger on a straight directed course; P2 (48:20) places the believing community on the same course. Bridge: a repeated scene signature with role progression from a singular addressee to plural addressees.
parent_channels.active_motifs: straight road (`quranic:root_000858:B001/m01`); intended direction and course (`quranic:root_001583:B002/m01`); straightness and equilibrium (`quranic:root_001273:B008/m01`).
parent_channels.ayah_anchors: P1 48:2 `ويهديك صراطا مستقيما`; P2 48:20 `ويهديكم صراطا مستقيما` (ه د ي; ص ر ط; ق و م).
parent_channels.synthesis: The formula returns with only the recipient number changed. The road remains invariant while guided agency broadens from the messenger to the community, so the opening and later restraint resolve as one collective trajectory rather than disconnected gains. Intended course gives the path direction, while equilibrium makes that direction regulative as well as traversable.

parent_channels.name: S10. P1-P2: A Control Question Is Answered by Dominion
parent_channels.scene_or_process: P1 (48:11) asks who can control anything against God when harm or benefit is intended; P2 (48:14) declares that the dominion of the heavens and earth belongs to God. Bridge: a question-answer sequence with the controller role reassigned from any supposed human holder to the divine sovereign.
parent_channels.active_motifs: ownership with power of disposal (`quranic:root_001444:B002/m01`); dominion and sovereignty (`quranic:root_001444:B003/m01`); the linchpin on which an affair depends (`quranic:root_001444:B005/m01`).
parent_channels.ayah_anchors: P1 48:11 `فمن يملك لكم من الله شيئا`; P2 48:14 `ولله ملك السماوات والأرض` (م ل ك).
parent_channels.synthesis: The same root moves from a denied verb of control to an explicit noun of dominion. The later declaration therefore answers the earlier question: disposal over harm, benefit, forgiveness, and punishment rests with the sovereign whose rule is the affair's supporting center. This fixes causal agency before the surah resumes its demands for accountable action.

parent_channels.name: S11. P1-P2: Excuse Turns to Bargaining and Countercharge
parent_channels.scene_or_process: P1 (48:11) has the left-behind speakers offer an excuse and request intercession despite a divided interior; P2 (48:15) has the same speakers seek access to gains and then attribute their exclusion to envy. Bridge: repeated participants and a causal discourse sequence progressing from self-exculpation to negotiation and counteraccusation.
parent_channels.active_motifs: saying what did not occur or falsely attributing it (`quranic:root_001272:B005/m01`); bargaining over an affair (`quranic:root_001272:B009/m01`); speech functioning as conjecture (`quranic:root_001272:B011/m01`).
parent_channels.ayah_anchors: P1 48:11 `سيقول لك المخلفون` and `يقولون بألسنتهم ما ليس في قلوبهم`; P2 48:15 `سيقول المخلفون`, `ذرونا نتبعكم`, and `فسيقولون بل تحسدوننا` (ق و ل).
parent_channels.synthesis: Repeated future-speech markers forecast changing tactics rather than one static claim. The first speech manages blame for past absence; the second bargains for future gain; refusal then produces a conjectural charge against the excluding group. The progression supports the surah's distinction between adaptive profession and enacted obedience by showing words changing with opportunity.

parent_channels.name: S12. P1-P2: Negation Exposes and Exempts
parent_channels.scene_or_process: P1 (48:11) uses negation to expose content absent from the speakers' hearts; P2 (48:17) uses the same operator to remove liability from the blind, lame, and ill. Bridge: a contrast and reversal in which denial first reveals a culpable mismatch and then performs exoneration.
parent_channels.active_motifs: denial of an asserted state (`quranic:root_001390:B001/m01`); exclusion from a set (`quranic:root_001390:B002/m01`); negation functioning as absolution (`quranic:root_001390:B003/m01`).
parent_channels.ayah_anchors: P1 48:11 `ما ليس في قلوبهم`; P2 48:17 `ليس على الأعمى حرج` (ل ي س).
parent_channels.synthesis: The repeated negator separates two kinds of absence. In P1, absent inward correspondence condemns speech; in P2, absent bodily capacity removes blame. The reversal usefully pressures any equation of incapacity with refusal: one negation uncovers failed sincerity, while the other protects those whom genuine impairment excludes from liability.

parent_channels.name: S13. P1-P2: Work Passes from Knowledge through Sight to Wage
parent_channels.scene_or_process: P1 (48:11) places human work under complete knowledge; P2 (48:24) places it under sight, and P2 (48:29) joins righteous work to forgiveness and a great wage. Bridge: a causal sequence and evaluative role progression from intentional performance through oversight to compensation.
parent_channels.active_motifs: intentional act or work (`quranic:root_001046:B001/m01`); taking charge of an entrusted work (`quranic:root_001046:B003/m01`); wage or provision earned by work (`quranic:root_001046:B004/m01`).
parent_channels.ayah_anchors: P1 48:11 `بما تعملون خبيرا`; P2 48:24 `بما تعملون بصيرا`; P2 48:29 `وعملوا الصالحات` with `وأجرا عظيما` (ع م ل).
parent_channels.synthesis: Work is first known in its inwardly intentional character, then seen in its outward performance, and finally answered with compensation. The lexical movement through entrusted labor and wage materializes divine evaluation as an accountable work relation. It supports the surah's pressure on verbal claims by carrying performed obedience, rather than profession alone, into the promised outcome.

parent_channels.name: S14. Whole Surah: Daylight Opens, Peaks, and Closes
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Dawn opens into morning, daylight spreads, the sun reaches its noon balance, and late afternoon passes into mingled darkness.
parent_channels.active_motifs: dawn breathing open (`quranic:root_001533:B009/m01`); morning as the first part of the day (`quranic:root_000143:B001/m01`); daylight opening with illumination (`quranic:root_001559:B002/m01`); the sun standing at noon (`quranic:root_001273:B017/m01`); late afternoon before sunset (`quranic:root_000038:B003/m01`); twilight mixing into darkness (`quranic:root_001231:B007/m01`).
parent_channels.ayah_anchors: 48:9 `بكرة` and `أصيلا` (ب ك ر; ء ص ل); 48:10 `نفسه` (ن ف س); 48:5 and 48:17 `الأنهار` (ن ه ر); 48:2 and 48:20 `مستقيما`, with `قوما` at 48:12 and 48:16 (ق و م); 48:27 `مقصرين` (ق ص ر).
parent_channels.synthesis: The explicit morning and late-afternoon poles open onto a complete daily arc. Dawn, full daylight, noon balance, and twilight fill the interval between them, so the command to glorify in 48:9 becomes a day-encompassing rhythm rather than two isolated observances. The latent cycle supports constancy as disciplined recurrence across changing conditions of visibility.

parent_channels.name: S15. Whole Surah: Honing, Sheathing, and Wielding a Sword
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A sword is held by its hilt, honed from dullness into a penetrating edge, housed in a scabbard, and wielded so that its sheen or blow leaves a trace.
parent_channels.active_motifs: sword hilt (`quranic:root_000529:B005/m01`); honing iron on a sharpening stone (`quranic:root_000750:B003/m01`); cutting sword passing through a blow (`quranic:root_000858:B003/m01`); sword scabbard (`quranic:root_001212:B010/m01`); sword sheen or mark of its blow (`quranic:root_000011:B007/m01`); dullness of an edge (`quranic:root_001315:B001/m01`).
parent_channels.synthesis: Readiness is assembled and maintained: grip governs the blade, honing restores its edge, and the scabbard contains it between uses. The trace belongs only to actual deployment. This materializes the surah's restrained hands and eventual fighting as controlled force whose effectiveness depends on preparation, containment, and timely use, not permanent exposure of the blade.

parent_channels.name: S16. Whole Surah: Cultivating and Settling a Sharecropped Field
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A field is divided into plots, cultivated by a tenant for a known share, protected from animals and birds, brought to yield and harvest, and settled through outgoing dues and incoming revenue.
parent_channels.active_motifs: divided farm plots (`quranic:root_000458:B015/m01`); tenant cultivation for a known share of produce (`quranic:root_000387:B003/m01`); crop yield emerging (`quranic:root_000009:B007/m01`); field figure that drives off animals and birds (`quranic:root_001359:B005/m01`); crop becoming ready to harvest (`quranic:root_000630:B006/m01`); fixed outgoing produce, rent, or levy (`quranic:root_000400:B003/m01`); incoming estate revenue (`quranic:root_000464:B006/m01`).
parent_channels.ayah_anchors: 48:22 `الأدبار` (د ب ر); 48:11 `خبيرا` (خ ب ر); 48:10 and 48:16 `يؤتي` (ء ت ي); 48:29 `زرع` and `الزراع` (ز ر ع); 48:29 `أخرج` (خ ر ج); 48:5, 48:17, 48:25, and 48:27 forms of `دخل` (د خ ل); 48:6 `لعن` (ل ع ن).
parent_channels.synthesis: The final crop image acquires a social and economic process around its growth. Plots define responsibility, tenancy joins labor to a specified share, protection preserves the developing yield, and harvest closes in an account of what goes out and what comes in. This supports the surah's gains and promised reward as managed yield arising through stewardship and settlement, not as unaccounted acquisition.

parent_channels.name: S17. Whole Surah: Drawing Milk in Repeated Letdowns
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A milker approaches a full udder from the proper side, uses a calf to induce letdown, leaves a small amount to draw the next flow, and protects the udder while milk replenishes between milkings.
parent_channels.active_motifs: full raised udder (`quranic:root_000350:B005/m01`); side-positioned milker (`quranic:root_000170:B009/m01`); using a calf to induce letdown (`quranic:root_001355:B007/m01`); milk retained to call forth the next flow (`quranic:root_000478:B003/m01`); abundant recurring milk (`quranic:root_000563:B006/m01`); milk replenishing between milkings (`quranic:root_001188:B006/m01`); protective bag tied over a goat's udder (`quranic:root_000011:B012/m01`).
parent_channels.ayah_anchors: 48:27 `محلقين` (ح ل ق); 48:1 `مبينا` and 48:29 `بينهم` (ب ي ن); 48:11 `بألسنتهم` (ل س ن); 48:16 `ستدعون` (د ع و); forms of `رسل` at 48:8-9, 48:12-13, 48:17, and 48:26-29 (ر س ل); 48:10 `فوق` (ف و ق); 48:29 `أثر` (ء ث ر).
parent_channels.synthesis: The operation turns livestock into renewable provision through positioning, stimulation, restraint, and intervals of replenishment. It extends the flock latent in the repeated gain language: benefit is not exhausted by taking once, but depends on preserving the source and drawing from it at the right time. This reframes repeated gains as husbanded yield with duties of care.

parent_channels.name: S18. Whole Surah: Protecting Gestation Until Delivery
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A fetus remains concealed, pregnancy becomes visible, delivery approaches through labor, a midwife receives the newborn, and afterbirth, postpartum blood, and uterine pain mark the vulnerable aftermath.
parent_channels.active_motifs: fetus concealed in the womb (`quranic:root_000266:B007/m01`); pregnancy becoming outwardly visible (`quranic:root_000531:B010/m01`); birth drawing near (`quranic:root_001212:B012/m01`); labor contractions (`quranic:root_000946:B008/m01`); midwife receiving the emerging child (`quranic:root_001198:B007/m01`); birth and postpartum bleeding (`quranic:root_001533:B005/m01`); afterbirth emerging with the child (`quranic:root_000822:B006/m01`); uterine pain after delivery (`quranic:root_000552:B004/m01`).
parent_channels.ayah_anchors: 48:5 and 48:17 `جنات` (ج ن ن); 48:27 `الرؤيا` and 48:29 `ترى` (ر ء ي); 48:15 `انطلقتم` (ط ل ق); 48:18 and 48:27 `قريبا` (ق ر ب); 48:15, 48:16, and 48:23 `قبل` (ق ب ل); 48:8 and 48:28 forms of `شهد` (ش ه د); 48:10 `نفسه` (ن ف س); 48:14, 48:25, and 48:29 forms of `رحم` (ر ح م).
parent_channels.synthesis: The birth process gives concrete force to the protected unknown believers in 48:25. Concealment is a life-bearing state, delivery requires the right stage and a receiving hand, and the aftermath remains vulnerable even after emergence. The scene therefore supports delayed entry as protection rather than failed arrival: forced action before differentiation could injure lives not yet safely brought into view.

parent_channels.name: S19. Whole Surah: Arbitrating a Dispute into Settlement
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Opposing parties each assert a right, entrust their dispute to an arbiter, receive a deciding judgment that opens the impasse, reconcile, and enter reckoning or recompense.
parent_channels.active_motifs: disputants each claiming the right (`quranic:root_000347:B004/m01`); appointment of an arbiter (`quranic:root_000348:B005/m01`); judgment between people (`quranic:root_000348:B002/m01`); judicial opening that decides between opponents (`quranic:root_001124:B003/m01`); settlement removing estrangement (`quranic:root_000876:B002/m01`); reckoning and recompense (`quranic:root_000504:B002/m01`).
parent_channels.ayah_anchors: 48:26-28 forms of `حق` (ح ق ق); 48:4, 48:7, and 48:19 `حكيما` (ح ك م); 48:1, 48:18, and 48:27 forms of `فتح` (ف ت ح); 48:29 `الصالحات` (ص ل ح); 48:28 `دين` (د ي ن).
parent_channels.synthesis: The opening root supplies a judicial operation as well as access or victory: a blocked conflict is opened by a decision. Claim, delegated authority, judgment, settlement, and reckoning form one procedural sequence. This reframes the surah's binding word and restrained confrontation as conditions for an ordered resolution in which right is decided and consequences assigned without uncontrolled combat.
